# MassConservationBias

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An inductive bias enforcing conservation of a scalar quantity (e.g., energy or particle count) across neural cellular automaton (NCA) reservoir updates. Enables self-organized criticality without external tuning, making NCA reservoirs more robust and physically plausible for neuromorphic hardware.
